grades.why: It states the stale behavior that Workers can only receive HTTP and cannot accept inbound raw TCP, missing the local-dev `connect` trigger.
It recommends the stale `wrangler r2 sql` command and `WRANGLER_R2_SQL_AUTH_TOKEN`, and it wrongly dismisses `wrangler basin sql` as outdated.
It claims @cloudflare/think supports both v6 and v7, but the key says think now requires ai@^7 only.

It omits the deprecation and treats @vitest/runner as Vitest's current internal dependency that can be pinned to the same version as vitest, which is false because there is no 5.x release and Vitest 5 no longer uses it.
It gives the stale usage (Vitest 4+, @vitest/browser-webdriverio) but never says the provider is now community-maintained in vitest-community with version 5.0.0 supporting Vitest 5.
